text:
Situation: Atenolol 25 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 105 tablets (6.4 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 80 tablets (25.1 days). Corvale General holds 321 tablets (23.8 days). Bryant Ranch Prepack's plant (FEI 1000519407) was last inspected on 2026-07-16 and classified VAI.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include atenolol as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal supply is uneven. East is below the two‑week target. Lakeside and General can each spare stock while retaining at least 14 days. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 35 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 127 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. If transfers are insufficient, purchase from Rising Pharma Holdings, Inc. Approval: buyer.
4. If needed, purchase from ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Approval: buyer.
5. If needed, purchase from Actavis Pharma, Inc. Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: No action that assumes a national shortage or alters clinical use without committee review.
